notes: Consolidated Declarative Watch Face Format (<WatchFace>) samples from android/wear-os-samples: all seven WatchFaceFormat samples (Complications, Flavors, PhotosMask, PhotosMulti, SimpleAnalog, SimpleDigital, Weather) and all three WatchFacePush samples (defaultwf, firefly, river). Upstream structures these as eight separate standalone Gradle builds without a root settings.gradle.kts; patches/0001-root-build.patch adds a root Gradle build including the ten codeless watch-face modules and renames each res/raw/watchface.xml stem to a unique name (wff_*, wfp_*) so multi-module discovery and catalog spec pre-flight resolve all ten watch faces cleanly in one catalog.
